title: Colibrì: runs a 744B parameter frontier model on 25GB RAM in pure C
description:
Colibrì runs a 744-billion-parameter model on a laptop with 25GB of RAM, in pure C with zero dependencies. A model that size normally wants hundreds of gigabytes of memory or a rack of GPUs you'll never own. The author's blunt that it's slow, roughly a tenth of a token per second on his humble box, but it's a frontier model answering correctly on hardware cheaper than an H100's fan. #github #opensource

https://github.com/JustVugg/colibri
